walkthroughs.body_html:
Before money, people used barter — swap goods directly.

Problem: I have eggs and you have shoes — but what if you don't want eggs? 🥚

Money fixed this. Everyone wants money.

Money is:

  • A medium of exchange — to buy.
  • A store of value — to save for later.
  • A unit of account — to compare prices.
  • A standard of payment — to pay debts.

Today money comes in three forms:

  • Cash — notes and coins.
  • Card — debit or credit.
  • Digital — apps, contactless, online.

UK cash use is falling fast — most pay by card. 📱
